cleaned (add or read a worktree_cleaned flag on the record and only call
cleanup_if_pr_done when false) and change cleanup_if_pr_done/post_completion
logic to accept batched lookup inputs (e.g., collect pr_url/pr_number values
from results where record.status == Status::Done and record.pr_url.is_some() and
worktree_cleaned == false, then perform a single batched GH GraphQL query to
resolve PR states and dispatch per-PR cleanup calls), referencing the functions
and types: post_completion::cleanup_if_pr_done, post_completion::get_pr_state,
results, record.status, Status::Done, record.pr_url, and the new
worktree_cleaned flag.

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

Inline comments:
In `@crates/atc-cli/src/health.rs`:
- Around line 139-145: The cost-warning println! calls print auxiliary messages
to stdout before the final JSON payload, breaking --json parsing; update the
loop that calls cost_warning(&r.record, cost_threshold) (iterating over results)
to either skip printing when the json boolean is true or write messages to
stderr (e.g., eprintln!) instead of println!; apply the same change to the other
auxiliary prints referenced around the later block (lines handling
progress/warnings, ~210-228) so all non-JSON output goes to stderr or is
suppressed when json mode is enabled.
- Around line 151-175: The post-completion fallback call to
post_completion::run_post_completion currently persists recovered data but
leaves the local in-memory snapshot (results) stale; after a successful call to
post_completion::run_post_completion (the call in crates/atc-cli/src/health.rs
that passes PostCompleteInput into post_completion::run_post_completion), update
the in-memory results for the affected record(s) using the returned
post-completion data or re-fetch the single affected row(s) from the registry
before continuing (i.e., before any auto-cleanup/auto-dispatch logic and before
building display_records); apply the same update/re-read approach to the other
post-completion invocations in this file so the snapshot reflects recovered
PR/URL/cost info.
- Around line 179-199: The current auto-cleanup loop uses the health-check
snapshot `results`, missing dispatches that were already `Status::Done`; replace
that iteration with loading terminal Done records from the registry via
`registry.list(...)` (filtering for `Status::Done` and those with `pr_url`) and
iterate those rows instead, using `config.dispatch.resolved_worktree_base()` and
calling `post_completion::cleanup_if_pr_done(url, &record.worktree_path,
&worktree_base).await`; keep the same checks for `worktree_path.exists()` and
use `r.record.pr_url`/`r.record.worktree_path` (or equivalent fields from the
registry rows) so worktrees for previously-completed dispatches are cleaned up.
- Around line 147-175: The fallback call to post_completion::run_post_completion
in the health check is causing PR worktree cleanup to run unconditionally;
modify the logic so artifact extraction and PR cleanup are separated — either by
splitting run_post_completion into two functions (e.g., extract_artifacts and
cleanup_if_pr_done) or by adding an explicit cleanup flag parameter to
run_post_completion and plumbing that flag from the health command; then call
only the artifact-extraction path (or call run_post_completion with
cleanup=false) when invoked from the stale-record fallback in health, and ensure
the cleanup path is invoked only when (auto_flag || config.health.auto_review)
before calling cleanup_if_pr_done (or calling run_post_completion with
cleanup=true).
```

</details>
